# TestScript for 99-kitchen-sink
# Asserts the exhaustive type matrix, configuration-mapping patterns,
# feature gates, and environment binding across all four
# decoder formats. The configs/ directory is the single fixture source
# (documentation for manual runs, copied in here).

# Isolate the conventional XDG config tier from the host machine.
env HOME=$WORK/home
env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$WORK/xdg

copy-fixture configs/config.toml config.toml
copy-fixture configs/config.json config.json
copy-fixture configs/config.yaml config.yaml
copy-fixture configs/config.hcl config.hcl

symlink deploy-hook -> run.sh

# 1. Root run per format: the curated root flags bind from top-level keys,
#    including the api_secret key remap
exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.toml
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+config\.toml\s+● cli --config-file'
stdout '-v, --verbosity\s+conga\.Counter\s+2\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--format\s+string\s+yaml\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--cache\s+bool\s+false\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--secret-key\s+string\s+remapped-secret\s+● config config\.toml'
! stdout '--session-id'

exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.json
stdout '-v, --verbosity\s+conga\.Counter\s+4\s+● config config\.json'
stdout '--format\s+string\s+hcl\s+● config config\.json'
stdout '--secret-key\s+string\s+json-secret-key-abc123\s+● config config\.json'

exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.yaml
stdout '-v, --verbosity\s+conga\.Counter\s+3\s+● config config\.yaml'
stdout '--format\s+string\s+toml\s+● config config\.yaml'
stdout '--secret-key\s+string\s+yaml-secret-key-def456\s+● config config\.yaml'

exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.hcl
stdout '-v, --verbosity\s+conga\.Counter\s+9\s+● config config\.hcl'
stdout '--format\s+string\s+json\s+● config config\.hcl'
stdout '--secret-key\s+string\s+hcl-secret-key-xyz789\s+● config config\.hcl'

# 2. Primitives: every integer, unsigned, float, and slice width
exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.toml types primitives
stdout '--string-flag\s+string\s+toml-configured\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--bool-flag\s+bool\s+true\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--int8-flag\s+int8\s+8\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--int32-flag\s+int32\s+3200\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--uint16-flag\s+uint16\s+1600\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--uint64-flag\s+uint64\s+64000\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--float32-flag\s+float32\s+1\.5\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--float64-flag\s+float64\s+3\.14159265359\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--tags\s+\[\]string\s+\[toml, prod, monitored\]\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--ports\s+\[\]int\s+\[8080, 8443, 9090\]\s+● config config\.toml'

exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.json types primitives
stdout '--string-flag\s+string\s+json-configured\s+● config config\.json'
stdout '--float64-flag\s+float64\s+3\.04\s+● config config\.json'

exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.yaml types primitives
stdout '--string-flag\s+string\s+yaml-configured\s+● config config\.yaml'

exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.hcl types primitives
stdout '--string-flag\s+string\s+hcl-parsed\s+● config config\.hcl'

# 3. Value types: duration, URL, byte size, enum, native map
exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.toml types values
stdout '--timeout\s+time\.Duration\s+1m30s\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--endpoint\s+url\.URL\s+https://api\.example\.com/v2\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--max-size\s+conga\.ByteSize\s+50MB\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--level\s+string\s+warn\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--shard-map\s+map\[string\]string\s+web=3, worker=5\s+● config config\.toml'

exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.json types values
stdout '--max-size\s+conga\.ByteSize\s+60MB\s+● config config\.json'

# 4. Filesystem domain types (File with existing/executable/symlink tags, Dir)
exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.toml types filesystem
stdout '-i, --input-file\s+conga\.File\s+/etc/hosts\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '-o, --output-dir\s+conga\.Dir\s+/tmp\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--log-file\s+conga\.File\s+/var/log/demo\.log\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--data-dir\s+conga\.Dir\s+/var/lib/demo\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '-e, --editor\s+conga\.File\s+.*sh\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--hook\s+conga\.File\s+deploy-hook\s+● config config\.toml'

# 5. Config mapping patterns: native map vs array-of-strings encodings
exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.toml config maps
stdout '--context\s+string\s+production\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--vars\s+map\[string\]string\s+APP_ENV=production, DB_HOST=localhost, LOG_LEVEL=debug\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--labels\s+map\[string\]string\s+team=platform, tier=frontend, version=2\.1\s+● config config\.toml'

exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.json config maps
stdout '--context\s+string\s+staging\s+● config config\.json'
stdout '--vars\s+map\[string\]string\s+APP_ENV=qa, DB_HOST=db\.local, LOG_LEVEL=info\s+● config config\.json'

# 6. Deeply nested config sections
exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.toml config nested
stdout '--zone\s+string\s+eu-west-1a\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--count\s+int\s+5\s+● config config\.toml'

exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.hcl config nested
stdout '--zone\s+string\s+ca-central-1a\s+● config config\.hcl'
stdout '--count\s+int\s+15\s+● config config\.hcl'

# 7. Advanced: required flag, positional arguments, placeholders, DashArgs
exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.toml advanced required -k mykey web-api hello extra1 extra2 -- pass1 pass2
stdout '-k, --api-key\s+string\s+mykey\s+● cli --api-key'
stdout '<name>\s+string\s+web-api\s+● cli'
stdout '\[message\]\s+string\s+hello\s+● cli'
stdout '\[extras\.\.\.\]\s+\[\]string\s+\[extra1, extra2\]\s+● cli'
stdout '\[-- <args\.\.\.\>\]\s+DashArgs\s+pass1 pass2\s+● cli'
stdout 'Advanced: name=web-api message="hello" extras=2 passthrough=\[pass1 pass2\]'

# 8. Missing required flag still exits 2 even with a config file present
exit-status 2 kitchen-sink --config-file config.toml advanced required
stderr 'missing required flag: --api-key'

# 9. Provenance: programmatic Changed/Source/SourceDetail reporting
exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.toml advanced provenance
stdout 'verbosity:  changed=true source=config'
stdout 'format:     changed=true source=config detail=config.toml'
stdout 'secret-key: changed=true source=config detail=config.toml'
stdout 'config:     changed=true source=cli detail=--config-file'

# 10. Field tagged config:"-" is rejected inside config files
exit-status 1 kitchen-sink --config-file excluded.toml
stderr 'field "temp_flag" is excluded from config files'

# 11. Help screen: grouped command tree, foreign tags lint-clean
exec kitchen-sink --help
stdout 'Commands:'
stdout 'types\s+Type system matrix \(primitives, filesystem, value types\)'
stdout 'config\s+Configuration mapping patterns'
stdout 'advanced\s+Required flags, arguments, trailing args, provenance'
! stdout 'session-id'

# 12. --why attributes values to their winning tier, redacts the API secret
#     and the env-var carrier, and shows per-key file origins for safe maps
exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.toml --why
stdout '--format\s+yaml\s+config \(config\.toml\)'
stdout '--secret-key\s+██████\s+config \(config\.toml\)'
stdout 'config\.toml\s+loaded'
stdout 'values are redacted'

exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.toml config maps --why
stdout '--vars\s+\(3 keys\)\s+config \(config\.toml\)\s+KITCHEN_SINK_VARS\s+config\.maps\.vars'
stdout 'APP_ENV=██████'
stdout 'config \(config\.toml\)'
stdout 'version=2\.1'

# 13. Feature state baseline: only the default-on gates are active, and the
#     feature-state command runs its post-run and finally lifecycle hooks.
exec kitchen-sink feature-state
stdout 'features: http3=false strict-tls=true metrics=true compression=1'
stdout '\[HOOK\] features PostRun: flushing feature report'
stdout '\[HOOK\] features Finally: closing feature audit log'

# 14. Per-feature environment variables derived from the container envprefix:
#     KITCHEN_SINK_FEATURE_<UPPER_SNAKE(feature name)>.
env KITCHEN_SINK_FEATURE_HTTP3=true
env KITCHEN_SINK_FEATURE_COMPRESSION=2
exec kitchen-sink feature-state
stdout 'features: http3=true strict-tls=true metrics=true compression=2'
env KITCHEN_SINK_FEATURE_HTTP3=
env KITCHEN_SINK_FEATURE_COMPRESSION=

# 15. A field env tag overrides the derived name (strict-tls), and env:"-"
#     opts a field out of the environment entirely (metrics). The help screen's
#     Features section renders one automatic [env: ...] hint per bound field.
exec kitchen-sink --help
stdout '\[env: KITCHEN_SINK_FEATURE_HTTP3\]'
stdout '\[env: KITCHEN_SINK_STRICT\]'
! stdout 'KITCHEN_SINK_FEATURE_METRICS'

env KITCHEN_SINK_STRICT=false
exec kitchen-sink feature-state --why
stdout 'strict-tls\s+false\s+env'
env KITCHEN_SINK_STRICT=

env KITCHEN_SINK_FEATURE_METRICS=false
exec kitchen-sink feature-state
stdout 'metrics=true'
env KITCHEN_SINK_FEATURE_METRICS=

# 16. A leveled feature accepts only its enumerated non-zero levels.
env KITCHEN_SINK_FEATURE_COMPRESSION=3
exit-status 2 kitchen-sink feature-state
stderr 'invalid value "3" for feature "compression"'
env KITCHEN_SINK_FEATURE_COMPRESSION=

# 17. Feature-gated members are pruned from help and completion, and invoking
#     them while inactive is a usage error (exit 2). The CLI map flag and the
#     per-feature environment both activate the gate.
exec kitchen-sink --help
! stdout 'experimental'
! stdout 'http3-port'

exec kitchen-sink __complete export --
! stdout '"value":"--http3-port"'
exec kitchen-sink __complete export ""
! stdout '"value":"experimental"'

exit-status 2 kitchen-sink --http3-port 9000
stderr 'flag .--http3-port. requires feature "http3"'
exit-status 2 kitchen-sink experimental
stderr 'command "experimental" requires feature "http3"'

env KITCHEN_SINK_FEATURE_HTTP3=true
exec kitchen-sink --help
stdout 'experimental'
stdout '--http3-port'
exec kitchen-sink experimental --probe
stdout 'experimental: QUIC listener on :8443 probe=true'
env KITCHEN_SINK_FEATURE_HTTP3=

# 18. The features config section maps onto the same gates in every format.
exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.toml feature-state
stdout 'features: http3=true strict-tls=true metrics=true compression=2'
exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.json feature-state
stdout 'features: http3=true strict-tls=true metrics=true compression=1'
exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.yaml feature-state
stdout 'features: http3=true strict-tls=true metrics=true compression=2'
exec kitchen-sink --config-file config.hcl feature-state
stdout 'features: http3=false strict-tls=true metrics=true compression=1'

# 19. The validation hook rejects the unobservable plaintext-metrics combination.
env KITCHEN_SINK_STRICT=false
exit-status 2 kitchen-sink feature-state
stderr 'metrics require strict TLS'
env KITCHEN_SINK_STRICT=

# 20. Flag environment binding: EnvPrefix derives KITCHEN_SINK_<NAME>, an env
#     tag overrides it (KITCHEN_SECRET), and env:"-" removes the tier entirely
#     (temp-flag). --why redacts the credential-bearing secret.
exec kitchen-sink --help
stdout '\[env: KITCHEN_SINK_CONFIG\]'
stdout '\[env: KITCHEN_SINK_FORMAT\]'
stdout '\[env: KITCHEN_SECRET\]'
! stdout '\[env: KITCHEN_SINK_TEMP_FLAG\]'

env KITCHEN_SINK_FORMAT=yaml
env KITCHEN_SECRET=hunter2
exec kitchen-sink --why
stdout '--format\s+yaml\s+env\s+KITCHEN_SINK_FORMAT\s+format'
stdout '--secret-key\s+██████\s+env\s+KITCHEN_SECRET\s+api_secret'
stdout 'values are redacted'
env KITCHEN_SINK_FORMAT=
env KITCHEN_SECRET=

env KITCHEN_SINK_TEMP_FLAG=nope
exec kitchen-sink
stdout '--temp-flag\s+string\s+—'
env KITCHEN_SINK_TEMP_FLAG=

# 21. The prefix-derived config-file variable selects the file to load.
env KITCHEN_SINK_CONFIG=config.toml
exec kitchen-sink feature-state
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+config\.toml\s+● env KITCHEN_SINK_CONFIG'
stdout 'features: http3=true strict-tls=true metrics=true compression=2'
env KITCHEN_SINK_CONFIG=

# 22. WhyOptionJSON opts into machine-readable provenance; an unknown format is a
#     usage error (exit 2). (.env loading is covered in dotenv.txt, which
#     isolates the process-environment effects in its own working directory.)
exec kitchen-sink --why=json
stdout '"schemaVersion":1'
stdout '"name":"http3"'

exit-status 2 kitchen-sink --why=xml
stderr 'invalid value "xml" \(must be one of: text, json\) for --why'

-- run.sh --
#!/bin/sh
echo hook executed

-- excluded.toml --
temp_flag = "nope"
